kinds.name: New element

kinds.name: New CA rule

kinds.name: Deepen
kinds.what: make an existing system richer, or wire two together

kinds.name: Connect
kinds.what: link two places or systems that ignore each other

kinds.name: Polish
kinds.what: make what is there read better; add nothing

kinds.name: Interaction/UX
kinds.what: how you read, poke or navigate the diorama

kinds.name: Scale/World
kinds.what: change the size, span or time of the world itself

kinds.name: Harness
kinds.what: the loop's own instruments — gates, probes, runlog, stats. Changes nothing a viewer sees, and does NOT count toward a domain's balance

watch: mapFlat ASKS THE WRONG QUESTION and three passes have now re-derived the answer. The seven structural scalars measure the GRID; the grid has been FULL since #100 (GW 138 x WH 88, every quarter allocated, growing WH moves every hard-coded row in 13,900 lines). Do NOT argue it a fourth time. The honest 4b moves are a new TILE or SPECIES constant (+9 in the summed census per kind: GLASS #116, REED #155, b170) or DEPTH beyond the grid, which the census cannot see (#145 the mirror, #150/#162 the far ranks). Re-pin with census.mjs --save-baseline and SAY SO; the gate reads collapse, not delta.

PRICE THE BRIEF'S PREMISE - aimed at the manager. Three of the six briefs #144-#148 were mis-priced by the plan and the workers measured first and were right every time. Put the NUMBER a brief rests on INTO the brief and name where it came from; where there is no number, say so and make the measurement the deliverable.

MEASURE A SURFACE BEFORE YOU CALL IT DRAWN, and a number is not a picture. Per-class luma sd/mean, 1600x950 seed 42: SIDE.cross 0.121 - GRASS 0.131 - PATH.court 0.143 - ROAD 0.150 - WATER 0.177 - SIDE.quay 0.229 - WALL 0.240 - NEAR ROOF 0.281, the highest, whose darkness is drawNearRoof's stated intent (that closed c232 and saved 90 minutes). The two large classes still unmeasured on their own are the SILL (c259) and the BACKDROP above the roofline.

ANYTHING THAT MOVES THE FRAME must hold the padded WIDE ground cache for the whole move and repaint ONCE on release: drawGround costs 25-27 ms and FACES/faceAt are registered in gview's frame. #165 (the backdrop) and #166 (the follow) both do. What it costs is c258.
